##### Project general facts

Bluebell Residence is a thoughtfully designed residential development in Ajman, positioned as a strong investment opportunity with excellent long-term potential. The architecture reflects a modern contemporary style, enhanced with elegant detailing inspired by the bluebell flower motif, symbolising freshness and refined living. The building is designed with clean lines and functional layouts, offering well-planned apartments that prioritise comfort, efficiency, and everyday practicality in a rapidly growing and well-connected location.

The development offers a lifestyle that combines convenience with essential wellness and community-focused amenities. Residents benefit from a fully equipped state-of-the-art health club designed to support an active and balanced lifestyle. Its strategic location ensures close proximity to offices, schools, shopping centres, and public transport links, creating a highly accessible living environment with everything needed for daily life within easy reach.

Inside, Bluebell Residence features modern finishing with high-quality materials that create a clean and contemporary living atmosphere. Interiors are designed to maximise natural light and space, offering a comfortable and functional residential experience. Kitchens come fully equipped with built-in appliances, ensuring both practicality and ease of use. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to design and personalise their homes according to their own preferences and lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman the smallest yet most diverse of all emirates in UAE. Located strategically in the middle of the emirates, it borders Sharjah and only 10 km away from Dubai. Hence, it provides an easy commute to other emirates. The perennial sunshine of its golden shores sitting alongside the serene beaches is a heaven away from the hassles of life. Its untouched landscapes, misty mangroves, Age-old traditions and authentic culture, along with the contemporary infrastructure make it a unique place to experience.

Ajman’s diversity and sustainable development attracts a large number of investors who are keen to tap into its lucrative business opportunities. The opening of Ajman’s free zone and visa extensions for investors is injecting more liquidity into the local economy and is boosting the underlying confidence of foreign investors. New laws by the UAE government to grant citizenship to expatriates and easing the rules to provide a conducive atmosphere for them, Ajman is rapidly growing as a major hub for prospective investors to live and work in.

The overall vibe of this emirate, due to the rate of new developments and years’ old traditions, is so soothing that it has an edge over other emirates to cater to anyone seeking comfort, luxury, and tranquility at the same time.
